keep_local.title: Keep the group in Home Assistant only
keep_local.description:
The LEDs of {group} could be grouped in the ReefBeat app too, but no ReefBeat cloud account listing them is set up. Without it the group lives in Home Assistant only: the app does not see it, and may drive its LEDs apart.

To share the group with the app, add your ReefBeat cloud account (Settings > Devices & services > Add integration > Red Sea > Cloud API): this issue then goes away by itself. Or keep the group in Home Assistant only.

The group will not be written to the ReefBeat cloud. You can still add the cloud account later.

ungroup.title: Ungroup in the ReefBeat app
ungroup.description:
{group} holds LEDs of several models, which the ReefBeat app cannot group together: the app groups LEDs of one model only. These LEDs are still grouped in the app, which would drive them apart from the others: {leds}.

Ungroup them in the ReefBeat app: the group then lives in Home Assistant only (its order is global).

These LEDs will be ungrouped in the ReefBeat cloud (the app shows them apart). Home Assistant keeps driving them together.
